Stearman; 2nd, Tranter; 3rd, Wolton, 2 mins. 4.4 secs. Tapley and Briggs, standards. 880 yards.—R.
In the junior match Paddy Mullen was second in the 100 yards and Dave Marshall second in the 220. Tapley and Morrison were second and third in the quarter and Tranter second in the 880.
Bernard Chitty writes from Singapore to say that he has met “Splinter” Tranter out there and they both send their best wishes to all their fellow members.
At our Club Dinner we were pleased to see " Splinter " Tranter now home from Singapore, and hope that we shall see him turning out on the track next season.
